title: Foo Bar Taxi Multi-Tenant Analytics Platform
description: Fetch NYC TLC taxi data, design a multi-tenant ClickHouse schema, build a semantic metrics layer, expose HTTP API endpoints, add JWT-based tenant isolation for yellow vs green cabs, and instrument with Langfuse tracing.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must build a complete multi-tenant analytics platform from scratch: fetching NYC taxi trip data from TLC, designing a ClickHouse schema, defining semantic metrics, exposing API endpoints with JWT-based tenant isolation, and adding Langfuse observability tracing.

tasks.description: Download yellow and green taxi trip parquet files for January and February 2024 from the NYC TLC data source and load them into ClickHouse.
Design a unified analytics schema with a taxi_type discriminator, proper ORDER BY and PARTITION BY for multi-tenant time-range queries.
Define semantic business metrics (avg_fare, total_revenue, trips_per_day, avg_distance) in a declarative configuration and build materialized views or rollup tables for fast aggregation.
Build HTTP API endpoints for trips listing, metrics queries, and summary dashboards with filtering by taxi type and date range.
Implement JWT-based authentication using secrets from /data/auth/ so that yellow-tenant tokens only see yellow cab data and green-tenant tokens only see green cab data.
Instrument all API endpoints with Langfuse tracing so each request produces a trace with spans for authentication, query generation, and execution.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse (empty, greenfield). JWT auth materials pre-staged in /data/auth/. Langfuse keys available via environment variables.
